S01.name: 余烬司炉
S01.visual: 铁灰炉膛、琥珀裂缝、扇形排烟片

2.name: 余烬司炉 · 2 件
2.text: 主攻击命中灼烧目标，本次直接伤害 +8%
2.text_en: Primary attacks against burning targets deal +8% direct damage.

4.name: 余烬司炉 · 4 件
4.text: 主攻击成功施加灼烧后，直接伤害 +10%，持续 3 秒；ICD 8 秒
4.text_en: Successfully applying Burn with a primary attack grants +10% direct damage for 3 s. Internal cooldown: 8 s.

6.name: 余烬司炉 · 6 件
6.text: 击败灼烧目标时发出余烬，对附近最多 3 名其他敌人各造成 X×35% 附加伤害；ICD 6 秒
6.text_en: Defeating a burning target releases embers that deal extra damage equal to 35% of X to up to 3 other nearby enemies. Internal cooldown: 6 s.

S02.name: 鸣轨导体
S02.visual: 靛蓝轨道、分叉铜导线、断续电符

2.name: 鸣轨导体 · 2 件
2.text: 主攻击命中感电目标，冲刺剩余冷却减少 0.15 秒；ICD 2 秒
2.text_en: Primary attacks against shocked targets reduce remaining dash cooldown by 0.15 s. Internal cooldown: 2 s.

4.name: 鸣轨导体 · 4 件
4.text: 主攻击命中感电目标，向最多 2 名其他敌人各释放 X×25% 电弧；ICD 4 秒
4.text_en: Primary attacks against shocked targets release arcs that deal 25% of X to up to 2 other enemies. Internal cooldown: 4 s.

6.name: 鸣轨导体 · 6 件
6.text: 6 秒内主攻击命中 3 个不同感电目标，攻击速度 +10%，持续 5 秒；ICD 10 秒
6.text_en: Hitting 3 different shocked targets with primary attacks within 6 s grants +10% attack speed for 5 s. Internal cooldown: 10 s.

S03.name: 霜潮潜衣
S03.visual: 乳白贝壳、冰蓝层片、圆缺冰晶

2.name: 霜潮潜衣 · 2 件
2.text: 主攻击施加的寒冷持续时间 +20%
2.text_en: Chill applied by primary attacks lasts 20% longer.

4.name: 霜潮潜衣 · 4 件
4.text: 主攻击命中寒冷目标，获得最大生命 4% 护盾；ICD 5 秒
4.text_en: Primary attacks against chilled targets grant a shield equal to 4% of maximum health. Internal cooldown: 5 s.

6.name: 霜潮潜衣 · 6 件
6.text: 主攻击命中寒冷目标产生霜环，最多对 3 名其他敌人造成 X×30% 附加伤害并施加寒冷；ICD 6 秒
6.text_en: Primary attacks against chilled targets create a frost ring that deals extra damage equal to 30% of X and applies Chill to up to 3 other enemies. Internal cooldown: 6 s.

S04.name: 铜蚀药师
S04.visual: 青铜药罐、青绿腐蚀孔、细管与滴形窗

2.name: 铜蚀药师 · 2 件
2.text: 主攻击命中腐蚀目标，本次直接伤害 +8%
2.text_en: Primary attacks against corroded targets deal +8% direct damage.

4.name: 铜蚀药师 · 4 件
4.text: 主攻击成功施加腐蚀时恢复最大生命 1%；ICD 3 秒
4.text_en: Successfully applying Corrosion with a primary attack restores 1% of maximum health. Internal cooldown: 3 s.

6.name: 铜蚀药师 · 6 件
6.text: 主攻击命中腐蚀目标产生酸性爆裂，最多对 3 名其他敌人造成 X×35% 附加伤害；ICD 6 秒
6.text_en: Primary attacks against corroded targets create an acid burst that deals extra damage equal to 35% of X to up to 3 other enemies. Internal cooldown: 6 s.

S05.name: 堡垒誓卫
S05.visual: 方形玄铁、暖白盾纹、堡垒垛口

2.name: 堡垒誓卫 · 2 件
2.text: 自身有护盾时，直接伤害 +6%

4.name: 堡垒誓卫 · 4 件
4.text: 护盾实际吸收伤害后，攻击速度 +10%，持续 3 秒；ICD 6 秒
4.text_en: When a shield actually absorbs damage, gain +10% attack speed for 3 s. Internal cooldown: 6 s.

6.name: 堡垒誓卫 · 6 件
6.text: 护盾被敌人伤害打破后，1 秒后获得最大生命 10% 护盾；ICD 10 秒
6.text_en: When an enemy breaks your shield, gain a shield equal to 10% of maximum health after 1 s. Internal cooldown: 10 s.

S06.name: 沉锤断层
S06.visual: 黑岩块面、赭黄断层线、悬锤配重

2.name: 沉锤断层 · 2 件
2.text: 自身有护盾时，主攻击击退强度 +20%；免击退目标不转伤害
2.text_en: Primary attacks have +20% knockback while shielded. Knockback immunity does not convert this bonus to damage.

4.name: 沉锤断层 · 4 件
4.text: 有护盾时冲刺后首个主攻击，直接伤害 +12%；窗口 2 秒，ICD 3 秒
4.text_en: While shielded, the first primary attack within 2 s after a dash deals +12% direct damage. Internal cooldown: 3 s.

6.name: 沉锤断层 · 6 件
6.text: 护盾被敌人打破后，5 秒内下一次主攻击附带冲击波，对最多 3 名目标造成 X×40% 附加伤害；ICD 8 秒
6.text_en: After an enemy breaks your shield, the next primary attack within 5 s creates a shockwave dealing extra damage equal to 40% of X to up to 3 targets. Internal cooldown: 8 s.

S07.name: 棱镜测绘
S07.visual: 乌紫玻璃、白色刻度、偏轴三角镜

2.name: 棱镜测绘 · 2 件
2.text: 主攻击命中寒冷或腐蚀目标，本次暴击率 +6%
2.text_en: Primary attacks against chilled or corroded targets gain +6% critical chance.

4.name: 棱镜测绘 · 4 件
4.text: 对带寒冷或腐蚀的敌人主攻击暴击，主动技能剩余冷却减少 0.25 秒；ICD 2 秒
4.text_en: Primary-attack critical hits against chilled or corroded enemies reduce the remaining cooldown of the unlocked skill with the longest remaining cooldown by 0.25 s. Internal cooldown: 2 s.

6.name: 棱镜测绘 · 6 件
6.text: 对寒冷或腐蚀目标累计 3 次主攻击暴击，第三次附加 X×40% 单体校准伤害；ICD 5 秒，计数器触发后清空
6.text_en: Every third primary-attack critical hit against chilled or corroded targets adds single-target calibration damage equal to 40% of X, then resets the counter. Internal cooldown: 5 s.

S08.name: 逐风信使
S08.visual: 沙白织带、天青鳍片、双尾风标

2.name: 逐风信使 · 2 件
2.text: 冲刺后 2 秒内首个主攻击命中感电目标，冲刺剩余冷却减少 0.2 秒；ICD 3 秒
2.text_en: The first primary attack within 2 s after a dash reduces remaining dash cooldown by 0.2 s if it hits a shocked target. Internal cooldown: 3 s.

4.name: 逐风信使 · 4 件
4.text: 冲刺后 2 秒内主攻击施加任一敌方状态，移动速度 +12%，持续 3 秒；ICD 6 秒
4.text_en: Applying any enemy status with a primary attack within 2 s after a dash grants +12% movement speed for 3 s. Internal cooldown: 6 s.

6.name: 逐风信使 · 6 件
6.text: 有护盾时冲刺，在起点留下风痕，对最多 3 名敌人各造成 X×35% 附加伤害并施加寒冷；ICD 8 秒；X 取本次冲刺时职业基础攻击快照
6.text_en: Dashing while shielded leaves a wind trace at the starting point, dealing extra damage equal to 35% of X and applying Chill to up to 3 enemies. Internal cooldown: 8 s. X uses the class basic-attack snapshot at the time of the dash.
